status: Native configuration and packet decoder staged; no hardware installation or ABI yet
configuration: Sensor-frame accel and six-axis quaternion at 25 Hz; unused outputs/batching/step indicators off; every patch uses verified bounded RAM writes. Does not enable hardware execution or interrupts.
decoder: One wire packet at a time; accel XYZ signed16 or quaternion XYZ signed32 Q30. Preserves low-nibble header flags. EAGAIN for incomplete packets, EPROTO for unknown headers, no output modification on failure. Caller must retain partial tails and flush/restart on corruption. No scalar reconstruction or accuracy claim.

packet_controls: Every partial length for both packets
tests.scope: Host harness compiles real C with modeled regmap. No native physical FIFO or IRQ test.

remaining: Execution state and configuration restore on raw/DMP switching
Native IIO channels and quaternion scalar convention
IRQ FIFO drain with partial-tail, overflow/reset/timestamp handling
Physical native execution and DMP suspend wake
